Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vikram - 28 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Neeta - 56 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Hema - 33 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Anita - 32 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The mall - a row of shops, an escalator
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
4. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The mall - Day

[Vikram stands in the mall. Neeta stands near him.]

Vikram: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vikram tries on a new jacket.]

Vikram (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Vikram pays at the counter.]

Vikram (surprised): "Yes, all right."

[Vikram carries the shopping bags out.]

Neeta: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vikram stands in the living room. Neeta and Anita stand near him.]

Vikram: "Mom, look over here."

[Vikram nearly dies laughing at the joke.]

Vikram (laughing): "Okay."

[Vikram plays dead to fool his sister.]

Vikram (gently): "Anita, look at this."

[Vikram's phone dies in the middle of the call.]

Vikram (softly): "What next?"

Scene 3: The hospital ward - Day

Neeta: "So, here we are!"

[Vikram lies down on the hospital bed.]

Vikram: "Show me too!"

[Vikram sits in a wheelchair.]

Vikram: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 4: The office - Day

Vikram: "Mom, look over here."

[Vikram sits down at his desk and starts typing.]

Neeta: "Yes, all right."

[Vikram presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Neeta: "What next?"

[Vikram shakes hands with the new client.]

Vikram (happily): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
